title: The Gadarene demoniac and the 'appointed time'

tellings.quote: Jesus was in in the land of Gdara with his disciples
they would chain him up in the tombs because he would scream.
tellings.difference: Adds the detail that he was chained in the tombs and screamed, and credits the New Testament instead of Jesus.
tellings.link_reason: Both tell the Gospel encounter with the Gadarene demoniac in the land of Gadara, and the teller is the same.

as_told.title: Gadarene demoniac chained in the tombs

plain: In a Bible story, Jesus and his disciples came to the land of Gadara and met a possessed man whom the locals chained up in the tombs because he would scream, and the spirits in him spoke of an "appointed time." The researcher Tim Alberino retells it from the New Testament gospels and ties it to the Book of Enoch, an ancient religious text, in the translation by R. H. Charles, to suggest the spirits knew of a set day of judgment awaiting them.
